references.name: downstream-and-spillway
references.use: Ordinary visual reference only;not a redistributed texture
references.observed: Ordinary aerial inspected:whole broad curved rock-fill barrier,crest road,eight exposed parallel penstocks descending the western/southwestern side toward a long low powerhouse,gate tower and broad divided eastern spillway chute,tailrace channels and separate terraced slopes/service roads. Current standard PMTiles resolves reservoir northeast and downstream southwest in the retained frame. No copied DSI lettering or logos;exact heights,bay counts and water levels remain estimates.
